result.summary: The interface is generally functional, but exhibits minor stylistic inconsistencies and legibility issues.

issues.description: Food illustrations lack visual consistency, alternating between sharp vectors and blurry, dark backgrounds.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the illustration style or use high-quality photography across all restaurant listings.

issues.description: Small white text on the promo banner has insufficient contrast against the lighter sections of the green gradient.
issues.suggestion: Increase the font weight or darken the background to ensure the text is clearly legible.
